name: moving_average_forecast
description: Forecasts using the average of the last 24 observations for hourly data
code:
def forecast(history: list[float], horizon: int, frequency: str) -> list[float]:
    window = min(len(history), 24)
    avg = sum(history[-window:]) / window
    return [avg] * horizon

name: daily_moving_average_forecast
description: Forecasts using the average of the last 7 daily observations for daily data
code:
import statistics

def forecast(history: list[float], horizon: int, frequency: str) -> list[float]:
    window = 7
    if len(history) < window:
        window = len(history)
    avg = statistics.mean(history[-window:])
    return [avg] * horizon

name: daily_seasonal_average_forecast
description: Forecasts using the average of the same hour from the previous two days for hourly data with daily seasonality
code:
def forecast(history: list[float], horizon: int, frequency: str) -> list[float]:
    period = 24  # daily seasonality
    forecast = []
    for i in range(horizon):
        # Get values from same hour in previous two days
        idx1 = i
        idx2 = i + period
        if idx1 < len(history) and idx2 < len(history):
            avg = (history[idx1] + history[idx2]) / 2
            forecast.append(avg)
        else:
            # Fallback if not enough historical data
            forecast.append(0.0)
    return forecast

name: secondly_moving_average_forecast
description: Forecasts using the average of the last 60 observations for 1-second frequency data
code:
def forecast(history: list[float], horizon: int, frequency: str) -> list[float]:
    window = 60  # 60 seconds for 1-second frequency
    avg = sum(history[-window:]) / window
    return [avg] * horizon
